items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson day-to-day with ankle injury after exiting vs Titans; left stadium in protective boot. Questionable to return in-game then did not.
items.why: Ankle injury scrambling; boot post-game, monitored/treated this week.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley relief; ROS uncertainty for BAL offense/Henry/Flowers.
items.opportunity: Backup QB stream; check practice Wed

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase ruled OUT due to concussion after evaluation in first half vs Jaguars.
items.why: Possible concussion after hit; went to locker room without helmet.
items.implication: Tee Higgins and other CIN WRs elevated targets; monitor protocol.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley downgraded to OUT with hamstring injury after exiting early vs Rams; replaced by Tank Bigsby/Will Shipley.
items.why: Hamstring injury on early run; ruled out before halftime.
items.implication: Immediate RB handcuff elevation; Eagles offense further depleted.

items.text: Chiefs WR Tyquan Thornton suffered dislocated ankle (put back in place), carted off after career-best 111 yds 2 TDs; out indefinitely, eval tomorrow, made plane, good spirits.
items.why: Gruesome lower leg/dislocated ankle during big game.
items.implication: Long-term; further opens KC WR room with Rice doubtful.

items.text: ETR post-Sunday injury watch: Lamar (ankle), Chase (concussion)/Higgins (adductor), Saquon (hamstring)/Bigsby, Rice (hamstring)/Thornton (ankle), McConkey (foot agg), DJ Moore (shoulder), Pat Bryant (ankle), Mariota (knee), others.
items.why: Comprehensive Sunday injuries for fantasy monitoring into next week.
items.implication: Key statuses for waivers/ROS; align with Schefter/Rap.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore aggravated shoulder injury in loss to Patriots; not considered long-term issue as of now.
items.implication: Monitor week; early exit noted by Berry.
items.opportunity: BUF WR depth if limited next

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice downgraded to doubtful with hamstring.
items.implication: Likely out; Worthy/others up; Thornton also hurt later.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active (foot/ribs); ETR had bigger dock but expected to play.
items.why: Active despite foot aggravation/ribs; bigger projection dock per Levitan.
items.implication: Playable but monitored for snaps; Derwin James inactive separately.
items.opportunity: Primary WR targets if limited less than feared

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans officially active after GTD/optimistic ribs status; pushed to play.
items.why: Practiced late week; optimistic per team, Kittle noted fractured ribs suck but active.
items.implication: Bigger dock per Levitan but cleared; startable.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players: DeVonta Smith (hamstring), Dallas Goedert (knee), Lane Johnson (personal), Zack Baun (concussion). Smith/Goedert out pregame.
items.implication: Major PHI offense depletion with Saquon also out; Hurts/remaining elevated risk/reward.
items.opportunity: Targets to remaining WRs/TEs; OL impact

items.text: Puka Nacua expected to play with only small dock on projections (groin); Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. Officially active/return.
items.why: Schefter sources: no workload limit; ETR small dock only.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected vs Eagles; upgrade from prior absence.

items.text: Zay Flowers expected to play (hamstring); Levitan tinier dock, no hard pitch count expected per beat.
items.why: ETR expected; Levitan tinier dock citing no hard limit.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin officially inactive/out with hamstring for London game vs Colts.
items.why: Hamstring suffered late week in practice.
items.implication: WAS WR depth up; Deebo/others targets.
items.opportunity: Target share to remaining WAS WRs

items.text: Matthew Berry: This year's Javonte Williams (boring mid-round RB unsure talent/role who starts and crushes) was Chuba Hubbard.
items.why: Mid-round RB who no one wanted due to uncertainty but is starting and crushing.
items.implication: Strong endorsement for continued start/ROS value.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love frustrated with snap management (not injured, maintenance); limited in crucial situations/second half despite wanting more; coaches managing workload for long season.
items.why: Post-game comments: snaps managed for freshness/body, not pure injury; honest with coaches on feel.
items.implication: Committee/risk of limited high-leverage; frustration signal.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker inactive tonight (quad).
items.implication: Tetairoa McMillan and others full targets.

items.text: Not one but two Bhayshul Tuten touchdowns called back due to penalty.
items.why: Two TDs nullified by penalties in-game.
items.implication: Near-miss goal-line/redzone usage; positive underlying signal for JAC RB.

items.text: Projecting Kenyon Sadiq (back) in with very little injury dock; Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) out. Waiting confirmation.
items.why: No reports but little dock; Parkinson out.
items.implication: TE opportunity if confirmed; Jets context with Hall out.
